title: Essential image descent for a normalized native functor
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $X$ a Noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible in every local ring. Let $D$ be a normalized native functor of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-normalized-functor]. For every native derived object $M$, bounded adic constructibility holds if and only if $M$ is isomorphic to $D.JA$ for some source object $A$.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(1),(2), split from native realization proof steps 3, 6 and 7.

proof.text: Use nativeScalarForgetting_isEquivalence and the internal section-module equivalence to obtain an equivalence S on derived categories. The specified native encoding F carries the given bounded constructible object to a condensed bounded constructible object.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), Lemma 6.8.13 and Lemma 6.8.2; finite coefficient part of the native realization argument.

proof.text: Apply constructibleCocone_essSurjObj to F(K), obtaining a finite field E, a finite condensed object M and its ambient extension isomorphism. Apply F inverse to that isomorphism and compose with the inverse equivalence unit to identify the inverse encoding of the extension with K.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), Lemma 6.8.13 and Lemma 6.8.2; finite coefficient part of the native realization argument.

proof.text: At this E apply condensedFinite_integralTensor_model with D.coefficient E, giving L and a tensor-model isomorphism. Insert the raw localization of L at stage E into the common-stage source. Compose D.integral E, the tensor-model isomorphism, and S applied to the inverse-encoding isomorphism. Lift this isomorphism through the fully faithful S using preimageIso. This gives an object A with D.J(A) isomorphic to K.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), Lemma 6.8.13 and Lemma 6.8.2; finite coefficient part of the native realization argument.

proof.text: For the converse, destruct a common-stage source object as a finite stage and its raw integral representative L. Compose S applied to the inverse of its given image isomorphism with D.integral at that stage. Apply nativeIntegralTensor_constructible to this explicit integral tensor presentation.
